failure_message: R17 runtime verifier must be byte-for-byte identical to preserved R16 verifier.
root_cause: The frozen R21 wrapper delegated through R20 and R19 into preserved R17. R17 still required the canonical verifier to be byte-identical to the preserved R16 verifier, while R20 intentionally changed the canonical verifier to correct supported/research membership semantics and R21 preserved that corrected verifier. The inherited identity invariant was therefore incompatible with the frozen R21 verifier by construction.
notes: R21 static validation passed before physical execution.
No R21 qualifying run was executed.
The physical host/toolchain prerequisites visible before wrapper failure were valid and the control tree remained clean.

Prospective correction must bind the canonical verifier to the preserved R20 verifier instead of the obsolete R16 identity invariant, without weakening MSVC/link-smoke/parser/dual-surface/self-test checks.
